exposure: Mode of labor induction (oral misoprostol vs. vaginal dinoprostone)
outcome: Neonatal outcomes (umbilical artery pH <7.20, one minute Apgar score)
cohort: 186 twin pregnancies ≥ 34 weeks gestation induced with either misoprostol (n=154) or dinoprostone (n=32) at St. Hedwig Hospital between 2002 and 2013
finding: Oral misoprostol and vaginal dinoprostone showed similar effectiveness and safety profiles for labor induction in twin pregnancies.
